The 59 commands include repeated regression checks and screenshots, not 59 unique test cases. Setup, exploratory runs, the preserved selector failure and older direct-tool checks are excluded. No paid provider or web-search request was made.

What the checks establish

  • Real SDK MCP discovers nine local application tools plus web_search. Calls travel through the actual assistant session and MCP transport.
  • A four-wall batch with a hosted door and window saves through the active design controller. Real undo and reload preserve the verified saved state and job identity.
  • Stale revisions, pre-aborted requests, unknown tools and unsupported draftsman actions are rejected. Draftsman tools require the current ready project and a mounted Model viewer; they cannot navigate away from unfinished work.
  • Play immediately returns active:true with status. Exit immediately returns active:false,status:null and restores the solid model.

Boundaries and retained failures

The isolated browser restarted with an empty fixture. Same-job reload was verified during this run; recovery of the earlier browser profile is not claimed. Final authored geometry was restored to its previous empty state at saved design revision 5.

The first playback attempt used an incorrect test selector and is preserved in its failed log. Full desktop images replace the first vertically clipped captures. The stale immediate active receipt was reproduced and then closed by the final regression above.

No native, production, mobile layout, live Gemini response, cross-device save or blueprint/PDF export acceptance is claimed here. Those are separate scopes. No normal user data, CRM files or external messaging was used.
